AdminForge.//AllowPrivateTargets: Let server-side tools reach RFC1918, loopback and link-local addresses. Off by default: a public instance with this on is an open SSRF proxy. Turn it on only for a homelab instance that is not reachable from the internet.
AdminForge.//ToolTimeoutSeconds: Wall-clock budget for a single server-side tool run.
AdminForge.//MaxResponseBytes: Ceiling on any outbound HTTP response body.
AdminForge.//MaxRedirects: Redirects followed, each re-validated against the target rules.
AdminForge.//BlockedHosts: Extra hostnames or IP literals to refuse, on top of the built-in private ranges.
AdminForge.//InstanceBanner: Optional notice shown on every page, e.g. to mark a public demo.
